channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Skate ASICS' Crisp New Shoes Until They Literally Turn Blue
item.description: ASICS' "Wear Away" skate shoe is basically a mood ring for your feet. Talk about skate park aura.

item.title: Oakley's Olympic Vision Isn't Just About Victory
item.description: Oakley has built its reputation on challenging accepted beliefs in sport. At the Olympics, wwe caught up with Oakley’s President, Caio Amato, and Brian Takumi, VP of Creative & Soul, to talk about the Games significance.

item.title: The Grass Is Always Greener, As Are Kevin Durant's Emerald-Toned Basketball Nikes
item.description: Kevin Durant and Nike's KD18 basketball shoe line is no stranger to churning out hits. But this emerald-colored style is destined for on- and off-court successes

item.title: adidas' Most Classic Sneaker Dresses up In Washed Indigo Denim
item.description: Dropping in two inverted colorways, the adidas Originals Galaxy OG Denim features a full textile upper in two tones of indigo denim.

item.title: Tremaine Emory Wants Denim Tears to Teach You What History Books Won't
item.description: Denim Tears' Spring/Summer 2026 collection is a prime example of Tremaine Emory's vision for his label, the creative director explains in interview.

item.title: Nike’s Seriously Suave Sneaker Is More Ready for the Streets Than the Pitch
item.description: Nike's Tiempo Streetgato sneaker is a stylish indoor soccer shoe offered in street-ready colorways like "Olive Aura."

item.title: The Infrared-Hot Return of an Original Nike Air Max Sneaker
item.description: Nike's iconic Air Max 90 "Infrared" sneaker is back in 2026, with some small stylish updates. Here's everything on the revival.

item.title: Nike’s GORE-TEX ACG Stomper Boot Is Built for the Wild & Beyond
item.description: The Nike ACG Gaiadome GORE-TEX is a stylish heavy-duty boot designed for the slopes & beyond.

item.title: This Might Be Vans’ Craziest Checkerboard Skate Shoe Yet
item.description: Vans' Authentic Shell Knit does the iconic checkerboard design in a new way: with a literal knit cover.

item.title: The Whitaker Group's Artful adidas Sneaker Is an Elegant Everyday Flex
item.description: The Whitaker Group releases its adidas sneaker collection featuring luxe classics like the Gazelle & BW Army.
